'''Mordekai''' was a [[Bogwing/Legends|bogwing]] who was kept as a pet by the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Reom]], the president of the company [[IsoTech]]. Mordekai resided with Reom on-board the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[The Wheel/Legends|the Wheel]], on which the headquarters of IsoTech were situated, and during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Mordekai was present when Reom met with a group of freelance operatives aboard the station to hire them to travel to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cholganna/Legends|Cholganna]] in search of the missing [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Sa Nalaor/Legends|''Sa Nalaor'']].
